children: Piper Sandler maintained their Overweight rating on Beacon Financial's stock with a price target of $35.00.
The price target implies an upside of 13.4% from the Oct 26 close of $30.86.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Beacon Financial has committed to significant operational improvements, including targeted cost reductions and an increased emphasis on share buybacks. These initiatives are expected to enhance efficiency and drive a mid-teens return on tangible common equity (ROTCE) next year, instilling confidence in investors and contributing to the maintenance of the Overweight rating.

: With the company's concentration in commercial real estate (CRE) now below 300%, management is better positioned to pursue growth initiatives. This strategic shift, combined with a healthy loan pipeline and anticipated increases in net interest margin (NIM), supports a positive outlook for future performance, reinforcing the rationale for the Overweight rating.
